summary.text: Robert Dover is a member of the Nebraska Unicameral Legislature representing District 19, and was appointed on July 22, 2022, to replace Michael Flood, who resigned, and was elected in 2024, according to the Legislature's biography.
The Legislature lists Robert Dover's occupation as a real estate entrepreneur.

paragraphs.text: Robert Dover was born on December 21, 1958, in Norfolk.
Robert Dover graduated from Norfolk High School in 1977 and earned a B.A. in business finance and Spanish from Wayne State College in 1988.
Robert Dover served as Nebraska real estate commissioner from 2007 to 2013.
Robert Dover is a member of the Nebraska Realtors Association and the board of the Nebraska Chamber of Commerce.
Robert Dover married Ann Bernadette Schneider on August 8, 1993, and they have four children.
